Landing Page Settings User Guide

Target Audience: Application Developers, Consultants, Trainees
Prepared by: Waseem Akram P
Platform Version: 6.0

Overview​

  • The Procify Landing Page Settings provides a robust, secure, and performant solution for creating dynamic homepage experiences. By following this documentation and implementing the recommended best practices, developers can create powerful, user-friendly homepage systems that scale with organizational needs while maintaining security and performance standards.

  • For additional support or advanced configuration requirements, consult the Procify development team or refer to the latest API documentation.

  • Note: KloGuid and KloLink controls will be disabled when added inside the embedded subscreens. Since the homepage uses embedded sections to display the screens, they will appear to be disabled as well. If required please use sap.m.Link control.

Pre-requisites​

Need Landing Page Settings to be assigned as TESTER
NOTE: For existing applications, a migration script is given to fill the title of the homepage with the title of the screen to show in the tab. It is recommended to do the flavor build once so that the title will reflect in the UI.

How to use the feature​

SNSteps
1Assign the homepage_editor as a TESTER to yourself Go to Procify Workspace Hub and assign the latest version of homepage_editor flavor to yourself as a tester.
2Go to the Landing Page Settings Once assigned, you will get the Upgrade Banner. Once you get the upgrade banner and registration is complete, Click the Hamburger menu and select App Builder Menu Header. Select Landing Page Settings from the Menu. You will be Navigated to the Landing Page Settings. Note: The Edit button will be disabled if no flavor is selected from the drop down.
3Make sure you are in bolversion 7-2-227 or Higher Note: You can check this from the about page
4.Select the flavor to create/see the homepages in that flavor. Once you select the flavor, the edit button will be enabled. If there are homepages in that flavor that will appear in the list. Once you have selected the flavor, it will persist even if you refresh and homepages in that flavor will be persisted
5.Click the Edit button to go into Edit Mode Once you Click the Edit button, the page will go to Edit Mode. You should now be able to see Add, Delete, Save and Cancel Buttons.
6Click On Home Icon below the Hamburger Menu in the sidebar to navigate to Home Page If you have not added any Homepage entries in the Landing Page Settings, then Procify Logo with Procify text is shown below it
7Click on + Add button A new homepage entry will be created Fill in the screen id in the page column by clicking the Value Help Icon and selecting the screen you like. Fill in the sequence and Tab Text. Click on Save. Once Save is successful the page will reload and You can click the Homepage button again to see the added Home Page. If one Homepage entry is added, then that homepage is shown in the screen.
8Add another Homepage in another flavor Go to Landing Page Settings and Select a different flavor, Click on Edit to Go Into Edit mode. Click on +Add button. Fill the screen id and changed the Tab Text if you want. Go to the homepage. If there are more than one entries in homepage, then You will see a tab with icon and title (icon filled from the tab_icon and title will be filled from the tab_text fields of the Landing Page Settings) In Mobile, back button is removed and the title in the screen titlebar will be dynamically updated based on the currently selected tab and filled from the title property of the Landing Page Settings, if not provided then picked from the Tab Text otherwise screenid. Precedence: Tab Text=> Screen Title => Screen Id Precedence: Title => Tab Text => Screen Id If no homepages are added then the title “Home” is shown in the screen title bar.
9Now in the roles field, select the role other than the role currently assigned to the user Here the app is assigned as TESTER to the user but we are selecting as manager Since the role doesn’t match, the screen is not shown to the user i.e., it is hidden from the user.
10Add permissions to your entity Create a permission group in Role Permissions if it doesn’t exist Enable Excel Download permission for testing purpose. Then Go to Landing Page Settings and In Edit Mode, Select the required permission from the Permissions dropdown. Then if the permissions is valid, then the Homepage is Visible otherwise it won’t be visbile NOTE: Make sure that all the permissions are assigned for all the users by default, even after assigning the permissions to the homepage and permission not given and homepage is still showing up then remove the permission group “flv_master_grp” from the Role Permissions screen for your user role.
11You can trim the subscreen by passing Page Parameters. Eg: {"trimSubscreen": "s_notif_t_detail"}. Here s_notif_t_detail is the detail section’s subscreenid
12We can change the Icon which is shown in the Tab of the HomeScreen.
